chapters.text: Roles across the top, every app's sections down the side. Click a pill to change what a role can do.
Find a section with the search box (e.g. Finance, Payroll).
Click the section to open its actions: Read, Add, Edit, Delete, Approve…
Click a pill to choose None, Own, Team, Branch or All. It saves at once.
Click + under a role to choose who has it.
